name: Slate modules
description: Official modules for Slate CMS. Add your own registry URL under Modules → Sources.

modules.name: Forms
modules.description: Build forms in the dashboard (Content → Forms), place them anywhere with the Form widget in the editor, a Form custom field, the {{form:slug}} template tag or [form slug="…"], and manage every submission in one inbox with email notifications, spam filtering and CSV export.
modules.author: Slate

modules.name: Site Migration
modules.description: Move an existing website to Slate: content, post types, taxonomies, custom fields, media (auto-optimized), SEO, menus, settings and URLs with automatic redirects, plus an exact mirror of the design. Also keeps old links, asset URLs and form endpoints of the previous site working.
modules.author: Slate

modules.name: Auto CPT Generator
modules.description: Automatically create post types, taxonomies and custom fields — from a live WordPress site, a WordPress export file, a plain-English description (AI) or a JSON spec.
modules.author: Slate

modules.name: Comments
modules.description: Privacy-friendly comments for posts and any content type: threaded replies, moderation queue, spam protection that works with the page cache (no cookies, no third parties), email notifications, webhooks and REST API output.
modules.author: Slate

modules.name: Multilingual
modules.description: Publish your website in several languages: a language for every item, linked translations created in one click, language URLs (/es/…), automatic hreflang, html lang and social locale, per-language listings and search, a language switcher ({{languages}}), translated template strings ({{t:…}}) and language-aware REST API output.
modules.author: Slate

modules.name: Shop
modules.description: Products, a cart, checkout and orders: sell physical or digital goods with Stripe Checkout, Razorpay or manual payment (bank transfer / cash on delivery). Template tags for prices and add-to-cart buttons, an Orders inbox and email notifications.
modules.author: Slate
